name: VNext Compounding Engineering Learning Engine
objective: Reduce the marginal cost and elapsed time of future verified product advancement without weakening repository authority, verification, Product Reality, security, privacy, licensing, provenance, or merge gates.

detect: routine human checks that have deterministic substitutes
preferred_output_order: issue when automatic bounded implementation is not authorized
process_improvement.self_change_rule: Changes to orchestrator behavior use an ordinary feature branch, tests, exact-head preflight, fresh PR CI, and normal merge authority. The learning engine cannot weaken its own gates.

verification_cost_ladder.principle: Use the cheapest repository-authorized deterministic gate likely to expose a known class first, while preserving all required final gates.
verification_cost_ladder.learning_rule: Promote a cheaper earlier gate only from repeated verified evidence that it detects the defect class without weakening final verification.

scheduler_feedback.objective: maximize verified product advancement per hour subject to authority and fairness
rules: A KPI deviation triggers diagnosis, not automatic blame or gate weakening.
Two consecutive eligible-idle runs for a product are a P1 orchestration defect.
Waiting lanes rotate immediately after asynchronous gate dispatch.
Measured optimizer evidence may reorder already-eligible P5 work but never overrides P0-P4 or repository authority.

counterfactual_evidence.purpose: Measure whether reused learning actually removes work from later engineering cycles.
allowed_measures: measured_elapsed_seconds_avoided_when both compared durations are evidenced
counterfactual_evidence.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN; never estimate hypothetical time savings from intuition.

maturity_gates.level_3_reuse: prior capabilities are automatically selected when applicable
maturity_gates.level_4_optimize: measured recurring friction changes the development process
maturity_gates.level_5_compound: sustained comparable evidence shows higher verified advancement or lower rework/cycle time without quality regression

claims_policy: Do not call the system self-improving or compounding from architecture alone. Require sustained comparable outcome evidence.
